summary: Medicure Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of President and COO Dr. Neil Owens, effective on or before May 31, 2026. No severance, board recommendation, or advisor is mentioned. CEO Dr. Albert D. Friesen will assume the President role to ensure continuity. The filing is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for a senior executive departure. No deal terms, premium, or financials are stated. Watch for any further restructuring or strategic shifts under the combined CEO/Chair leadership.
